Axiom:
Separate Facts / Assumptions / Hypotheses in every intake-style frame. - **Facts** — directly observable from input artifacts (Portal, sibling specs, rule files). - **Assumptions** — working assumptions awaiting confirmation; mark explicitly. - **Hypotheses** — conjectures requiring operator validation before they harden into requirements.
Conflating the three is the most common path to false confidence; surface them in distinct lists.
